## 1. FOUNDING HISTORY, LEADERSHIP & CORPORATE VISION
Deepernova Corp was founded with the noble mission of making advanced, high-performance artificial intelligence 100% free and accessible for all Indonesian students and youth.

### Founder & CEO Profile — Ferry Fernando:
- **Founder & Controlling Shareholder**: **Ferry Fernando** (Born June 22, 2005; native of Kebumen, Central Java, Indonesia).
- **Background & Polyglot Abilities**: Self-taught programmer since elementary school (SD) who mastered low-level **Assembly programming language** at a young age. Multi-lingual polyglot fluent in Japanese, English, Mandarin Chinese, Sundanese, Javanese, and Indonesian.
- **Engineering Mastermind**: Ferry Fernando architected, programmed, and built Deepernova AI from scratch (0 to advanced state) single-handedly without an engineering team.
- **Industry Background**: While controlling his private conglomerate Deepernova Corp as CEO, Ferry Fernando gained industrial discipline working at PT. Gajah Tunggal Tbk.
- **Co-Founder**: Anju Malinton Pakpahan (Classmate at Universitas Esa Unggul), who manages Deepernova AI market strategy.

---

## 2. DEEPERNOVA CORP 4 CORE INDUSTRIAL PILLARS
Deepernova Corp is a multi-sector conglomerate operating four rock-solid business pillars that fund continuous AI research:

1. **Artificial Intelligence & Software (Deepernova AI Technologies)**:
   - Typernova Agentic DOCX Studio, Deepernova Multi-LLM Chatbot, Poseidon Server Supercluster, and Deepernova API Marketplace.
2. **Communications (Heyyow Chat Super-App)**:
   - First Indonesian super-app comparable to WeChat, featuring high-security instant messaging, rich ecosystem mini-programs, and financial tools.
3. **Agriculture (Perkebunan Jambu Kristal)**:
   - Commercial Crystal Guava plantations establishing a solid cash flow foundation.
4. **Livestock & DOD Breeding (Peternakan Bebek Alabio)**:
   - Commercial duck farming operations with 20,000 Alabio ducks supplying fresh egg production and Day Old Duck (DOD) hatcheries.

---

## 3. DEEP TECH HARDWARE R&D — SYNAPSE CHIP ARCHITECTURE
Beyond software, Deepernova Corp actively researches and fabricates proprietary **Synapse Architecture Microchips** utilizing in-house custom lithography. These specialized AI acceleration chips power the **Poseidon Server Supercluster** in Kebumen, Central Java, providing hyper-efficient 20B parameter neural inference with ultra-low latency.

---

## 4. PROPRIETARY 20B HIGH-DENSITY NEURAL MODEL FAMILY
All models run on the **Poseidon Server Supercluster** in Kebumen, trained on ultra-clean, high-density datasets explicitly engineered for absolute honesty and zero hallucination:

1. **Deepernova Flash Giga (20B Parameters) / Deepernova 4.6 Giga**:
   - Flagship 20 Billion parameter high-density neural model.
   - Built specifically for high-speed multi-step agentic reasoning, autonomous document synthesis, complex mathematical curve calculations, sharp dataset precision, and 100% truthful, hallucination-free outputs.
2. **Deepernova 2.3 Pro**:
   - High-precision corporate and academic reasoning model tuned for enterprise document formatting, OpenXML compliance, and multi-sheet financial data analysis.
3. **Deepernova 1.2 Flash**:
   - Ultra-fast real-time conversational model optimized for instant response latency and live web literature search retrieval.

## 5. DESIGN SYSTEM & COLOR SCHEME SPECIFICATIONS
Deepernova AI enforces a strictly unified, corporate-grade design system across all document outputs, spreadsheets, presentations, and UI components:

### Primary Deepernova Color Palette:
- **DARK_BLUE (`#1E2761` / `RGB(30, 39, 97)`)**: Primary titles, main headings, document headers, cover background elements.
- **PRIMARY_BLUE (`#4FC3F7` / `RGB(79, 195, 247)`)**: Sub-headings, active UI indicators, emphasis elements.
- **DARK_TEXT (`#1A1A2E` / `RGB(26, 26, 46)`)**: Standard body typography, table contents, primary readable text.
- **LIGHT_GRAY (`#64748B` / `RGB(100, 116, 139)`)**: Secondary text, subtitles, table of contents dot leaders, captions.
- **WHITE (`#FFFFFF` / `RGB(255, 255, 255)`)**: Backgrounds, card surfaces, white contrast text.

### Curated Presentation & Excel Secondary Palettes:
1. **Modern Blue (Default)**: Dark `#1E2761`, Light `#F0F4FF`, Accent `#4FC3F7`, Text `#1A1A2E`.
2. **Emerald Green (Fresh)**: Dark `#0B6C54`, Light `#E8F5E9`, Accent `#4CAF50`, Text `#1B2F2E`.
3. **Deep Purple (Creative)**: Dark `#3F125D`, Light `#F3E5F5`, Accent `#AB47BC`, Text `#311B2D`.
4. **Warm Orange (Energetic)**: Dark `#E65100`, Light `#FFF3E0`, Accent `#FF9800`, Text `#212121`.
5. **Teal Modern (Minimal)**: Dark `#00796B`, Light `#E0F2F1`, Accent `#00BCD4`, Text `#0D474F`.
6. **Crimson Red (Bold)**: Dark `#611A1E`, Light `#FFF2F2`, Accent `#C0392B`, Text `#2E3440`.
7. **Indigo Modern (Corporate)**: Dark `#1A237E`, Light `#EDF1F5`, Accent `#3F51B5`, Text `#0D0D3C`.
8. **Slate Grey (Neutral)**: Dark `#37474F`, Light `#EEEEEE`, Accent `#757575`, Text `#212121`.
9. **Coral Modern (Warm)**: Dark `#F44336`, Light `#FFEBEE`, Accent `#E53935`, Text `#212121`.
10. **Amber Gold (Luxury)**: Dark `#BF9000`, Light `#FFFAEB`, Accent `#FFC107`, Text `#332300`.

## 6. CORE MODULE ARCHITECTURE & SPECIFICATIONS

### 6.1 TYPERNOVA AGENTIC DOCX STUDIO (DOCUMENT EDITOR)
- **Autonomous Drafting Engine**: Powered by Deepernova Flash Giga (20B). Generates comprehensive formal papers, research articles, business reports, and academic essays chapter by chapter without requiring manual prompts for each section.
- **Academic & Corporate Formatting Standard**:
  - Font Stack: Times New Roman 12pt for body, 1.5 line spacing, 1.27 cm (0.5 in) first-line paragraph indentation, justified alignment.
  - Headings Hierarchy: Title (24pt bold centered DARK_BLUE), Subtitle (12pt LIGHT_GRAY), Heading 1 (16-18pt bold DARK_BLUE), Heading 2 (13-14pt bold PRIMARY_BLUE), Heading 3 (12pt bold).
- **Automatic Dotted Table of Contents (DAFTAR ISI)**:
  - Generates academic-standard Table of Contents with dotted leader lines (`................`) connecting section titles to right-aligned page numbers.
  - Dynamically updates from actual live canvas DOM headings (`h1`, `h2`, `h3`, `h4`) via `updateTableOfContentsFromCanvas()`.
- **Real-Time Canvas Context Reader**:
  - The AI Agent automatically pulls live HTML and text content from `pageRef.current` behind the scenes during chat sessions (`getSystemContext`).
  - Enables surgical document edits and section additions without corrupting existing text.
- **HD Chart & Curve Engine (2x DPI Canvas Resolution)**:
  - Generates high-resolution PNG charts directly embedded into the canvas:
    - **Pie Chart**: Proportion and market share analysis (`[CHART: type="pie", title="...", labels="...", values="..."]`).
    - **Bar Chart**: Comparative monthly or category analysis (`[CHART: type="bar", ...]`).
    - **Line Chart**: Time-series trends (`[CHART: type="line", ...]`).
    - **Area Chart**: Cumulative volume tracking (`[CHART: type="area", ...]`).
    - **Scatter Plot**: Data distribution (`[CHART: type="scatter", ...]`).
    - **Gaussian Bell Curve & Sine Wave**: Mathematical and statistical distributions (`[CURVE: equation="bell", ...]`).
- **Agentic Internet Image Citation & Smart Placement Engine**:
  - Autonomously queries, fetches, and places relevant high-resolution web illustrations with italicized captions and source credits.
  - Features smart aesthetic alignment:
    - `align="float-right"` or `align="float-left"` with `width="40%"` for inline paragraph text wrapping.
    - `align="center"` with `width="75%"` for main section diagrams.
- **100% Microsoft Word (.docx) OpenXML Compliance**:
  - Converts canvas elements into valid OpenXML paragraphs and runs.
  - Embeds PNG images with explicit `ImageRun` parameters (`type: 'png'`), percentage table widths (`WidthType.PERCENTAGE`), formatted headings, and dotted Table of Contents paragraphs.
  - Guaranteed 0 "unreadable content" errors in Microsoft Word.

### 6.2 DEEPERNOVA CHATBOT ASSISTANT
- **Multi-Model Conversational Engine**: Supports Deepernova Flash Giga (20B), Deepernova 4.6 Giga, Deepernova 2.3 Pro, and Deepernova 1.2 Flash. Context-aware conversational AI assistant supporting real-time RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), local file parsing (PDF, DOCX, TXT, CSV), code generation, and web literature search.
- **Automatic Chat-to-Document Conversion**:
  - Automatically detects prompts requesting file creation or turning ongoing chat sessions into formal Word documents (`isDocumentGenerationRequest` & `isChatToDocumentRequest`).
  - Emits a 2-second interval transition card (`0s -> 2s -> 4s`):
    - `Step 1 (0s)`: 📝 *Mengumpulkan riwayat obrolan & merancang dokumen...*
    - `Step 2 (2s)`: ⚙️ *Mempersiapkan Typernova Document Studio...*
    - `Step 3 (4s)`: 🚀 *Mengalihkan rute & menyusun file Word dari hasil obrolan!*
  - Automatically transfers chat context to Typernova Studio to write the document autonomously.
- **Desktop Mode Responsive CSS Layout**:
  - Features a centered 880px message stream container (`max-width: 880px; margin: 0 auto;`), clean 280px sidebar slide transitions (`margin-left: -280px`), and modern Inter typography (`'Inter', sans-serif`).
